rules: Keep allowOther as the type discriminant; allowOther:true must never expose a choice-only result type.
specs.spec: Closed-choice asks preserve their choice value union, while any ask that permits free text returns string because the durable answer may be outside those choices.

rules: Keep verb and key separate; do not reconstruct operation identity with string prefixes.
specs.spec: A Plugin decision key is domain identity, independent of the reconcile verb. Ask choices preserve Plugin-authored values end-to-end so results need no Store-specific translation.

rules: Keep verb and key separate; do not reconstruct operation identity with string prefixes.
specs.spec: Confirm is a constrained decision over the same operation identity model: the verb distinguishes it from ask, while accept and decline remain stable domain outcomes.
